name: Field
description: Represents a field. The Field object is a member of the Fields collection. The Fields collection represents the fields in a selection, range, or document.
remarks: Use Fields (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Field object. The index number represents the position of the field in the selection, range, or document. The following example displays the field code and the result of the first field in the active document. Use the Add method to add a field to the Fields collection. The following example inserts a DATE field at the beginning of the selection and then displays the result.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Field object.

properties.name: Code
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a field's code. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the field type. Read-only WdFieldType.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: True if the specified field is locked. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Kind
properties.description: Returns the type of link for a Field object. Read-only WdFieldKind.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a field's result. Read/write.

properties.name: Data
properties.description: Returns or sets data in an ADDIN field. Read/write String.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns the next object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns the previous object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the position of an item in a collection. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowCodes
properties.description: True if field codes are displayed for the specified field instead of field results. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LinkFormat
properties.description: Returns a LinkFormat object that represents the link options of the specified field. Read/only.

properties.name: OLEFormat
properties.description: Returns an OLEFormat object that represents the OLE characteristics (other than linking) for the specified field. Read-only.

properties.name: InlineShape
properties.description: Returns an InlineShape object that represents the picture, OLE object, or ActiveX control that is the result of an INCLUDEPICTURE or EMBED field.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the result of the field. Returns True if the field is updated successfully.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Replaces the specified field with its most recent result.

methods.name: UpdateSource
methods.description: Saves the changes made to the results of an INCLUDETEXT field back to the source document.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified field to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Removes the specified field from the document and places it on the Clipboard.
